budgets.estimate_limit: Conservative 5*(startup60+worker5+cleanup30)=475; not measured latency or syscall-bound guarantee. Foreground hard cap540, outer600; original min(deadline,now+30) cleanup is not extended.

max_attempts.readiness: only original bounded loop; no extra readiness-fault attempt

failure_policy: First failure/UNKNOWN STOP_RETAIN all raw/new output and result index; retry0. Only independently owned CID may be removed by frozen cleanup contract; no artifact deletion or B268 rewrite.
receipt_contract: Numeric PID/direct Popen wait+reap; adopted raw waitpid events/rawstatus->exit and actual ECHILD, primary/secondary errors, stdout/stderr/log hashes; CID absence never replaces waits.
owned_contract: CID exact image/name/owner label; raw inspect/isolation/wait/container exit/CLI numeric join; owned rm then strict raw absence predicate; no name-only deletion.
metadata_limits: B286 SOURCE_ONLY; no new candidate/helper/test/PG/Docker or metadata execution. B284 resource metadata and B285 actual experiment are historical, not current capacity guarantee.
P5 precondition and cleanup guard source are untested; real saved-Popen -9/reaped plus original gate branch and stop<=3 must be verified by separately authorized runs.
B285 actually spawned4 pg_stop versus cap3; append-only erratum included, original report/raw/index/P5 rejection unchanged.
Unconfirmed P5 cannot enter original Session cleanup: explicit UNKNOWN/failure, closedFalse, no fake reap/ECHILD; owned container teardown only under future exact host card.
Original2g/1g caps are not reserved/sufficient capacity guarantee; OOM/peak/competition/full/root-image remain unqualified.
